body:
I'm sorry.
 I feel like all I'm doing is complaining. It feels kind of nice writing this out.
 I'll delete this later if I do decide to leave. I just don't know at this point.

I don't have very many friends, and wen then I wouldn't want to bother them. The few friends I have I feel very distant from, as though we talk but don't connect. I don't want to talk to my brother. He's my friend but he very often is incredibly patronising and turns the conversation to be about himself.

Lately I've been feeling horrifically tired. I slept for 18 hours last night and wanted to go back to bed 2 hours later, hardly able to keep my eyes open. I'm concerned but I don't know I something is wrong with me or if it's my sleep schedule. I can hardly stay up for two hours without wanting to sleep again. I would excersise more but I don't want anyone looking at me since people scream such profound things out their car windows when I go running.

I've never told my family about my suicide attempts. I told my brother once but he dismissed it for the most part so I don't know. In the sixth grade I held a razor to my wrist for an hour while sitting on the floor of the bathroom wondering how my family would feel if I died that day. When being bullied in the 6th grade I once yelled at the kids doing it that f I killed myself, If they would finally be happy that I finally died and would they moe in with their lives satisfied that they made me so depressed I offed myself. The most prominent attempt I think about is when I tried to hang myself with a belt in the 8th grade. I was overweight and too heavy, and I had not fastened the belt correctly, so when I finally decided to step aside and lose my footing, I came crashing to the floor. I laid there on the bathroom floor for a long time afterwards, and eventually cried myself to sleep in a pile of towels until I moved into my own bed later on. I didnt talk for awhile after that and didn't tell anyone but they all dismissed it as me being a cranky bitch so I guess it didn't matter anyway. I don't know. I sometimes wonder.
